extracted.intended_audience: Researchers applying for ERC grants (applicants, potential applicants) and host institutions
extracted.subtask_description: Information and policies about ERC peer-review panel membership, the role of panel members and chairs, and rules applicants must follow regarding panel members. Covers lists of panel members by year and transparency-related guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-contact policy with reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants, potential applicants, or potential host institutions must not contact reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This information is given for reasons of transparency. If applicants or their host institutions contact reviewers, the applications may be rejected on the grounds of a breach of research integrity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency of panel membership information
rubrics_metrics.description: ERC publishes information about the panel members who took part in completed ERC grant competitions, and about panel chairs, both past and currently serving.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The listing of panel members and chairs is provided to ensure transparency of the peer-review process. The page shows results (e.g., 1–50 of 7,741) and provides names, associated review panels, funding schemes and years to allow public visibility of who served on panels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Panel composition and expertise
rubrics_metrics.description: Panel members are top scientists and scholars coming from all over the world to help ERC select the best project proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ERC panel membership is intended to gather high-level international expertise to ensure a comprehensive and robust assessment of research proposals. Panels are organised in three research domains and, at the time of publication, across 28 panels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Role of panel members in evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Panel members play a vital role in the ERC’s evaluation of grant proposals and help select the best project proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Panel members participate in completed grant competitions and contribute to the ERC's peer review process, which aims for thorough, robust assessment. The site provides panel membership by year, enabling tracking of who participated in specific competitions.
